sectionSubtitle: Engineered for maximum speed, absolute privacy, and universal media conversion without server costs.
badge: 100% Free • Unlimited Conversions • Zero Cloud Uploads
heroSubtitle: A completely free, 100% private client-side conversion engine. Transform images, audio, video, and documents instantly inside local browser memory using high-speed multi-threaded Web Workers and Web Audio API. Zero server uploads, zero subscriptions, and unlimited batch processing.

cards.title: 100% Client-Side Privacy
cards.description: Your files never leave your device. All decoding, compression, and encoding execute entirely inside local browser memory with zero network requests or third-party telemetry.

cards.title: High-Performance Web Workers
cards.description: Leverage your multi-core processor with a hardware-concurrency Web Worker pool and Transferable ArrayBuffers for rapid parallel conversions with zero main-thread UI lag.

cards.title: Universal Multi-Media Engine
cards.description: Convert across all digital assets: modern images (WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPG, ICO, SVG), audio decoding & PCM WAV resampling, video soundtrack extraction, and structured document transformations.

cards.title: Instant ZIP & PDF Merging
cards.description: Bundle batch conversions into compressed ZIP archives in memory with fflate, or assemble multi-image albums into single, publication-ready multi-page PDF documents.

cards.title: Advanced Tuning Controls
cards.description: Customize your output with granular controls: quality compression sliders, dimension resizing, aspect ratio locks, transparent background replacement, and EXIF metadata stripping.
